it is not enough to just use a parallel simulation program; one must also understand the simulation protocol and the simulation model, in order to achieve a good speedup.
a parallel discrete-event simulation program is unlikely to achieve the speedup predicted by a critical path analyzer, unless the model's inherent parallelism is high.
